notes.title: Resetting the leaderboard due to a bug fix (Updated)
notes.content:
On November 7, 2021, at 7:00 PST, an update will be released to fix the following issues and reset the leaderboard at the same time.

[h3]Fixed[/h3]

* Fixed a problem where, when a jackpot, demon extermination, or mini-game (hereafter referred to as "various events") occurred at the end of a challenge, the challenge would start with the various events carried over if the challenge was restarted.

* Fixed a problem where retrying at the end of a challenge would not reset the stage. (Added on 2021/11/6 5:06)

# The new leaderboard will be applied after the bug fix update is applied. This is a measure to prevent users play challenge mode in a situation where the problem occurs without applying the update to fix the problem.


[h3]Background of the Leaderboard Reset[/h3]

If you play Challenge Mode with this bug, you will be able to score more than usual. We have decided to reset the leaderboard because this situation is unfair to the users who are playing for the top ranking.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by the glitch and the resetting of the leaderboard.

notes.title: New demon & New features etc (Ver 1.1.0)
notes.content:
[h2]New features[/h2]

[list]
[*] New demons have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41195882/f2d388cb6cb6ae4303075970cc09235fb7414ad3.png[/img]


[*] Added decorative flags that can be purchased with coins. Up to 10 flags can be attached.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41195882/f8a95be34e939f32ba329e0936c3a73db9571c01.png[/img]


[*] Play results are now displayed at the end of normal mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41195882/078af8ef45db917116092a5138c7de5d9ceba536.png[/img]
[/list]


[h2]Improvement[/h2]

[list]
[*] Jackpot coins now fall in front of the player.

[*] Jackpot coin drop interval has been accelerated.

[*] Increased the number of initial coins.

[*] Added the ability to downgrade upgraded performance.

[*] The ability to downgrade has been added.
# If you want to upgrade a downgraded ability again, no coins will be consumed.

[*] Made it a little harder for prizes to roll down.
# This makes it less likely that they will fall directly out of the field when they appear.

[*] It is now possible to shot coins by holding down the shot button.

[*] The movement speed of the VRoid character is now changed to match the movement speed of the player.

[*] Changed so that players will not be forced to leave the game during a jackpot, even if they have not shoted any coins.

[*] Slightly lightened the processing load for physics operations.
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed coins would sometimes penetrate walls.

[*] Fixed the pottery would sometimes float in the Hit pottery event.

[*] Fixed multiple co-op events could occur simultaneously.
[/list]


# The game will not match players with different versions.
